spirits.name: Alice
about: Alice is a Spirit, who appears as a hedgehog, found in Spiritfarer. She can be found at Mount Toroyama. You must complete The Coziest Cottage quest in order for her to join you on your boat.
life: A stay-at-home mom, she spent most of her adulthood looking after her children and taking care of her family’s domestic life. Engaging with Alice meant doing so of your own volition, as she would never dare impose herself. However, she loved fashion, travelling, and Swedish romance novels, which she slowly reveals to Stella. Unfortunately, as she grew older, she started showing signs of dementia.
In Stella’s life, she represents a turning point in her vocation as a nurse. Alice was the first patient to die in Stella’s care, an experience that reaffirmed her will to work in end-of-life care.

spirits.name: Astrid
about: Astrid is a spirit. She is first encountered leading a worker's strike at Bottom Line Corp.
life: As a young woman during World War II, Astrid hid Jewish children in the basement of her mother's restaurant. She devoted the remainder of her life to helping others. Eventually, she met and married Giovanni. Though she deeply loved him, the two had a tumultuous relationship. Despite Giovanni regularly being unfaithful, she found it difficult to separate herself from him.
Stella met Astrid and her husband while she was a teenager living in France. The couple became surrogate grandparents to her, as Stella never knew her own.

spirits.name: Atul
about: Atul is a Spirit found in Spiritfarer. As stubborn as he is joyful, Atul is very handy, loves water and would never pass up a good (or bad) meal. Being on this boat with all of his fellow passengers really makes him miss his family, but it doesn't get him down too often.
life: Atul was Stella’s paternal uncle. He moved to north-eastern France at the same time as Stella and her parents, before they settled a decade later across the Atlantic Ocean. As a true handyman, he occupied various technical functions in many construction fields until he found his true vocation: union leader, fighting for the rights of disparaged workers.

Atul took great pride in teaching Stella all he could about life’s little things, from fishing to cooking, to simply sitting and enjoying the sunset. As cheerful and petulant as could be, Atul hid an emotional hole that unfortunately could not be filled, regardless of all the love he received, no matter how sensational the gourmet food he ate was.

While Stella was still in Europe in her early twenties, Atul disappeared without a trace. This was a great shock to Stella, and she never truly learned what had happened to him. His disappearance was one of the reasons Stella decided to move to North America with her mother Marie, and her sister Lily.

spirits.name: Beverly
about: Beverly is a Spirit found in Spiritfarer. She was released on August 31st in the Summer 2021 update.
life: Beverly is Stella's old neighbor. She'd been rather lonely on Oxbury and is eager to join Stella and reminisce about the past with someone familiar. She first mentions 3 people, Henry, Sarah and David. Henry and Sarah are her children, and David her husband, who passed before her. David was a math teacher for a high school named Chelsea High. Beverly met David on a blind date, as her friend Pauline, who was the school's secretary, matched them up. She also mentions that her family house was designed by a professional architect, yet had to sell it when she was alone, as her children had moved out. The house was a cozy little farmhouse and it meant the world to her. Beverly had many friends that she mentions very often, and she loves to tell stories to Stella.

Stella and Beverly met as neighbors when Beverly moved to the city after selling her farmhouse. It seems that as she got older, her memory started to fade, and began to forget names and recent events, causing her to repeat the same things to Stella over and over again.

spirits.name: Bruce & Mickey
spirits.dislikes: One ingredient food, Allergic to crustacean
about: Bruce and Mickey are Spirit characters in Spiritfarer.

Bruce (the hummingbird) does all the talking throughout the Journey. He speaks in a more tough manner, and will reminisce about their previous lavish life which eventually leads into them requesting a mansion (Bruce and Mickey's Crib) to be built.
life: Bruce and Mickey are two very odd patients most likely from just outside of Boston that Stella encounters during her senior year as an end-of-life care nurse. Mickey, an imposing and intimidating behemoth of a man, ends up in a coma after his drunk-driving leads to a car accident. His brother Bruce never leaves his side, accompanying him in the most extreme, dangerous, and illegal activities. The two of them are inseparable and, at Mickey’s arrival in Stella’s care, become a staple of the ward for many months.
It is implied that Bruce may have committed suicide, which is suggested in the Everdoor dialogue.

Bruce always talks “on behalf” of his brother, in denial that Mickey simply is not there anymore. Incapable of coming to terms with the fact that his brother, while technically alive, is not coming back, Bruce makes outlandish requests and angry or rude comments while aboard the ship, showing his pain.

spirits.name: Buck
spirits.originText: Hikarishima Lighthouse (after getting the Bounce Ability)
about: Buck is a spirit character of Spiritfarer.
He can be found atop Hikarishima Lighthouse after unlocking the bounce ability, and is the only spirit character that cannot be released at the Everdoor.

Buck will be the last spirit on your ship and will keep you company until the end of the game. He will entertain any completionists by offering mini errand quests after the final spirits depart. He will not have a quest that ends with taking him through the Everdoor.
life: In a strange way, Buck has already passed on when Stella meets him. In Stella’s life, Buck was her sister Lily’s friend who died in his teenage years. Stella remembers Lily’s recounting of many of Buck’s stories, after his death. Although Stella never actually met him in life, his story fascinated her, as well as the geeky personality Lily described when she talked about him. Buck’s habits of escaping his reality through tabletop RPG’s led Stella to believe, in a very peculiar way, that his attunement with the end of his life defined him. This made her fall in love with Role Playing Games, idealizing Buck in the process.

spirits.name: Daria
about: Daria is a Spirit character released on December 12th in the Fall 2021 update.
She is a patient at an old run-down hospital in Overbrook. Her caretaker is Jackie.

Daria experiences several mental and physical symptoms, including catatonia. She also discusses hearing voices that no one else can hear, suggesting auditory hallucinations. These symptoms led to her being institutionalized in young adulthood. Reaching Daria is challenging, as her room is at the top of a crumbling lighthouse in Overbrook, and the door is often guarded by Jackie. Playing through Jackie's quests will allow Stella increasing amounts of access to Daria.

spirits.name: Elena
spirits.event: Deadly Pulsar Rays, Severe Thunderstorm, Gold Dragon
spirits.dislikes: Fine Dining food, Meat, Fried food
about: Elena is a studious, teacher-like spirit. She is hard on Stella, putting her through several challenges without any praise, and criticizing her when she fails.
Upon completing these challenges, Stella is rewarded with 10 treasure maps which lead to important treasures of hers. Elena then instructs her to choose one of these to give up on.

In her lifestyle, Elena emphasizes on simplicity, ridding herself of unnecessary belongings and sentiments, as evidenced by her preference in food, lodging and her aversion towards hugs. She also expects the same behavior from those under her tutelage.
life: In life, Elena was a teacher. She worked in a school that made sure everyone would pass. It was the kind of school that's main lesson was that "money can buy everything". She was never impressed by any student that had come through her classroom, no one was focused enough for her. They were distracted, talkative, doing anything but paying attention to what Elena would attempt to teach. In her mind, there is one memorable day from her life. A student had come back from a rowdy gym class; it was Elena's first year on the job and the student was fuming. She was told to "shape the mind" of the youths who came through the halls. Though she tried to control them, they were too rowdy and wouldn't sit still. That day she snapped and screamed at the student. It was the first time that they listened. Elena had told them truths that would only reveal themselves later in life, truths that only came after losing someone or something dear to you. She focused on talent and excellence, to never let herself lose her resolve again. Elena hadn't ever felt useful to the gifted students, nor did she like breaking the spirit of the weaker students. She disliked seeing them just struggle as she tried to teach them, because they didn't know why she challenged them. She says she challenged them due to the fact that they never listened, which to Elena, is the easiest thing. But it was her favourite thing, she knew that eventually these students would learn. They would learn through the hardships and know how to survive, how to be better and how to become leaders.

Though she did have a favorite student named among . She was determined to get that scholarship that Elena would coach her as she saw the potential. However she did not get the scholarship and was devastated as she said it was a number's game.
Elena was one of Stella's final patients. While the cause of her death is unknown, the diagnosis that lead to her palliative care was extremely fatal and progressed rapidly.

spirits.name: Giovanni
spirits.lastQuest: One Last Drink for the Road
about: Giovanni is a lion with dark purple/grey fur. His mane is very thick, covering most of his body and is adorned with borages on his neck.
Before this, he had a very prominent nose but was already balding when he was under Stella's care.
life: Giovanni fought in World War II in the Resistance, then carved for himself an ordinary life of trade and simple pleasures. Extremely careful with his appearance and his witty one liners, Giovanni always made sure to do everything in his power to charm everyone around him, even if it sometimes involved doing shady things just to win someone’s heart. Up until his death by heart attack, Giovanni stood by his “Carpe Diem” motto. He understood the pain he had caused Astrid, without being truly sorry about it.

The charm and bravado however can be seen as a façade as seen through his Everdoor dialogue, that he had to be the funny guy and charm everyone he meets but he knows that they only really came for Astrid.

spirits.name: Gustav
about: Gustav is a tall, dark brown owl with red highlights. His Spirit Flower is positioned in the center of his chest.
life: As Stella travelled through Japan as a young adult, emancipated and in control of her life for the first time, she met Gustav. A German art curator who spent time teaching Stella nuances and invited her to his art gallery in Shirakawa-gō, Gustav had a brilliant career that led him to travel the world, curating exhibitions for a multitude of museums and galleries. His extensive knowledge of art, history, and architecture sometimes makes him come across as a smug intellectual.

At a relatively young age, Gustav developed multiple sclerosis. His condition physically paralyzed him, but left him with a clear mind. He continued working as much as he could, but his condition stifled his career, soured his mood, and forced his mind towards more contemplative subjects.
It can be assumed that this disease was what ultimately killed Gustav.

spirits.name: Gwen
about: Gwen is a tall, reddish-brown deer with three sets of ears. Her spirit flower is worn on her shoulders. In life, Gwen had a short bob cut as an adult.
life: Gwen’s parents had been friends with Stella’s family long before they moved to North America. As such, Gwen had been one of the very few constants in Stella’s life up to adulthood. Gifted with a brilliant mind and a pragmatic attitude, she had a mischievous side. Being a couple of years older than Stella, Gwen had always been a big sister figure for her; one who would always nudge her towards self-affirmation and taking the risks she otherwise wouldn’t dare to take on her own. She lived with Stella and Lily in France during their childhood.

Heir to an aristocratic but mostly dysfunctional family, Gwen had a difficult relationship with her father. He was proud of his daughter, but would often distastefully parade her and her intelligence as a way to receive self-aggrandizement. This was exacerbated by her father leaving Gwen and her mother at a fairly young age, to live with his boyfriend, Doug. Gwen only talked to the accountant a few times, including for several hours when her father died, and then never again.

Symbolic of her rebellious nature and her opposition to a guardian she had to call “Father”, Gwen picked up smoking at a very young age. Yet, despite all her courage and bravado, she never mustered the courage to smoke publicly or in front of him. Ironically, smoking is what eventually killed Gwen, when she passed from lung cancer in her 40s. As she reached the final stage of her disease, Gwen travelled back to her parent’s manor in Northern Italy’s Alpine Lakes region and considered attempting suicide.
Ultimately, Stella reached out to her at that moment, and succeeded in helping Gwen accept her fate rather than taking her own life.

spirits.name: Jackie
about: Jackie is a Spirit character released on December 13th in the Fall 2021 update.

He is a large, jovial, mixed-race caretaker at an old run-down hospital in Overbrook. His main patient is Daria. He worked with Stella when she was a nurse and he was an orderly, and envied her constant positivity and ability to deal with tough patients. Jackie, while personable and outgoing, neglected many of his orderly duties, leading to an accident with Daria and his eventual firing.

Jackie stands in as a foil to Stella's above-and-beyond nursing, in which she takes small requests from patients (and as the Spiritfarer) and performs them to the best of her abilities, ensuring the comfort and peace of all her patients, regardless if they are rude to her. While Stella is dedicated if overwhelmed (especially by younger patients such as Stanley), Jackie is burned out and lackluster about his job commitment, even going so far as to say "Why do I even do this?" followed by "everybody keeps thanking me" and "what else would I do?" While Stella treats her nursing as a vocation, Jackie treats his work as an orderly as an imposition.

spirits.name: Lily
about: Lily is the spirit manifestation of Stella's younger sister, unlocked after the third/final visit with Hades. She was released on April 20th in the Spring 2021 update.

Lily serves as a narrator for the definitive exposition of Stella's memories collected on her three visits to Hades. Going from shrine to shrine at night, the audience learns of Stella's life and personality through Lily's recollection.

Lily is Stella's foil, representing the softer sides to excited, compassionate, outgoing Stella. Lily admits she is more reserved, and was in awe of her sister's natural charisma. Upon their father contracting a terminal illness, Lily was present through the worst parts of it, watching him suffer, while Stella was in Japan on vacation. When Stella returned she looked at her father "as if, for a moment, [she] didn't even know him."

spirits.name: Stanley
about: Stanley is very cheerful and will have odd requests compared to many of the other passengers. He will ask you to put odd things in the Foundry, or cook strange items in the Kitchen. He's very curious, and creative and has a passion for putting on plays, drawing and talking to his friend Jacob the beetle.

He enjoys following you around, curious as to what the mighty captain is up to, expressing that he wants to be a captain like yourself when he gets older. He doesn't understand why people are mean sometimes, and can be easily disheartened. However, he always seems to bounce back, and cheer himself up again.
"I remember what my dad used to say. 'Stanley, people are not really mean. Sometimes their intentions just take the wrong path.'" - Stanley
life: Stanley is a wonderful 8-year-old boy who met Stella as he was losing his fight against a fatal disease. Cheerful and whimsical, Stanley is gifted with an analytical mind which allows him to crack one-liners and aphorisms. His wisdom makes full grown adults blush in humility.

As the youngest patient Stella ever had to take care of, Stan left an unforgettable imprint on her. He helped her realize that death can take many forms, and that wisdom and peace of mind can be found in the most unusual patients.

spirits.name: Summer
about: Summer is a brownish-green and yellow snake who wears a green cloak. Her Spirit Flower sits just below the hood of the cloak, where her chest would be. The tip of her tail, along with a small loop, comes through a sleeve on the cloak to act as a hand.
In life, she was rather stout and already elderly when under Stella's care.
life: A true child of the earth, Summer grew up on a midwestern farm, in a very strict household. Her job as an agronomic engineer led her to work with large farming corporations, where she developed breast cancer due to their heavy use of chemicals. Her sickness prompted her to leave her town behind, to heal. That is how she met Rose, the love of her life, and Stella's aunt.

During her recovery, Summer developed an interest in biodynamic farming. Her journey toward better health also led her to embrace her more spiritual side. It is at that point in her life that she vowed to live every day in the glow of what she called the universal love. With Rose, she built a blooming garden in a remote area for just the two of them. Many happy days were spent in this house they made for themselves, until Rose passed away.

Summer's last decade was filled with struggles. The loss of Rose left her adrift, and without her by her side, she found it hard to take care of herself. Then, when her cancer came back, it was for good. She died with Stella by her side.
Summer was the person who inspired Stella to become a nurse.

abilities.name: Double Jump
abilities.controls: While in the air, press [Jump] again to double jump.
details: Double Jump allows Stella to jump higher and reach previously inaccessible areas. It is the first ability to be unlocked.

abilities.name: Glide
abilities.controls: While in the air, hold [Jump] to glide.
details: Glide allows Stella to use air drafts to float upwards to gain height, and to fall down slowly and glide long distances before landing. Obtaining this ability unlocks the Air Draft structure blueprint.

abilities.name: Zipline
abilities.unlock: Nordweiler (requires the Icebreaker boat upgrade to reach)
abilities.controls: Hold [Up] to zipline on ropes and wires.
details: Zipline allows Stella to slide along hanging ropes or lines. Obtaining this ability unlocks the Zipline structure blueprint.

abilities.name: Bounce
abilities.unlock: Oxbury (requires the Rock Destroyer boat upgrade to reach)
abilities.controls: Press [Jump] to jump higher on bouncy surfaces.
details: Bounce allows Stella to bounce on certain items, such as dumpsters, umbrellas, and window awnings, to gain extra height. Repeated jumping will further increase the height. Obtaining this ability unlocks the Bouncy structure blueprint.

abilities.name: Dash
abilities.unlock: Greymist Peaks (requires the Mist Cleaner 1000 boat upgrade to reach)
abilities.controls: Press [Dash] to release Everlight energy and leap forward.
details: Dash allows Stella to leap forward at great speed, either from the ground or in the air. Dashing depletes the Everlight (turning it darker in appearance) for about 3 seconds before recharging.

abilities.name: Light Burst
abilities.controls: Press [Light Burst] to release Everlight energy in all directions around you.
details: Light Burst allows Stella to release a circular burst of light from her Everlight, interacting with specific request- and event-related items in range. This skill is required for Buck's request The Fires of Tondor and Buck's event Shadow Steel Orcs. It is also helpful for catching certain Event targets such as Dust Shades, Pulsar Rays and Jellyfish. Using it depletes the Everlight (turning it darker in appearance) for about 3 seconds before recharging.

abilities.name: Improved Tools
abilities.unlock: Lost Shrine (requires completing Errand "Saturday Night Shopping List", which is available after unlocking Light Burst).
abilities.controls: An Everlight booster that improves both your mining and your fishing.
details: Improved Tools upgrades Stella's fishing rod and pickaxe. Fishing becomes easier, and a gemstone drops upon mining certain veins.
Mining Coal will yield 1 Diamond
Mining Marble will yield 1 Opal

events.name: Aluminium Dragon
events.house: None; approach the front of the boat

events.name: Deadly Pulsar Rays
details: This is a harder variant of Pulsar Rays, where the pulsar rays take winding trajectories more often, and Stella's Boat gets bombarded with more pulsar rays.
Elena challenges Stella to collect at least 1/3 of the deadly pulsar rays as a part of the quest Elena's Dharma.

events.name: Dust Shades
details: Dust Shades is a manually-triggered Event that can only occur after Stanley's Playroom has been built. Bottled Ectoplasm can be collected after the event is introduced by the Spirit Stanley. Exactly 1 Bottled Ectoplasm will be collected for each Dust Shade that Stella touches during the event.
Like all events, the Dust Shades event can still occur after the Spirit helper leaves through the Everdoor.

events.name: Fireflies
details: During the event, clouds of fireflies appear on the right side of the screen and move to the left in mostly a straight line. The majority will appear gold in color and reward glim. Occasional red fireflies carrying small square pouches reward Fireglow Seeds.

events.name: Gold Dragon
details: The Gold Dragon is located at [121, 111] in the Hummingberg Region

events.name: Jellyfish Stage I
details: Jellyfish will appear from the right of the boat, flying towards the left. Green jellyfish will have a position indicator while off-screen. Touching jellyfish will give rewards.
There are three types of jellyfish:
Small yellow jellyfish give 10 Glims.
Large yellow jellyfish give 25 Glims.
Green jellyfish give Bright Jelly x2.
Before the event starts, you can reposition buildings on the boat up high, to provide ladders to reach jellyfish that appear higher up.

events.name: Meteor Shower
details: Meteor Showers are location-based Events where Comet Rock can be collected after the event is introduced byGiovanni.

Like all events, the Meteor Shower event can still occur after the Spirit helper leaves through the Everdoor. Instead of talking to Giovanni to start the event, it can be started by interacting with the second story door of Astrid's Bungalow.

events.name: Mind Palace
details: After triggering The Raft of the Medusa quest, Stella can play her guitar in different locations around Overbrook. Everytime she plays Daria's theme in those locations she will be transported to a platforming section representing Daria's mind and, in doing so, she'll learn more about the spirit's life.
After finishing each section Stella will be rewarded some Radiant Spring, which can be used in the Vending Machine to improve Overbrook and to unlock another Mind Palace section.

events.name: Nebula Pillbugs
details: After Alice joins you, the Nebula Pillbugs event can be played.

After heading to one of the locations where the event takes place, a large Nebula Pillbug will hop onto your boat. Speak with Alice to start the event. The Pillbug will release its children over the boat, allowing Stella to run around, collect the baby pillbugs and return them to the mother (giving Stella 1 nebula fiber per bug). Some of the baby pillbugs will glow and run around excitedly; if caught in this state, they return 2 nebula fibers.
Once all the baby pillbugs are caught, the mother will hop off the boat and the event ends.

events.name: Pulsar Rays
details: Pulsar Rays are location-based Events where Pulsar Ore can be collected after the event is introduced by the Spirits Bruce & Mickey. Exactly 1 Pulsar Ore will be collected for each Pulsar Ray that Stella touches during the event.

Like all events, the Pulsar Rays event can still occur after the Spirit helper leaves through the Everdoor. Instead of talking to Bruce to start the event, it can be started by interacting with the door to Bruce and Mickey's Crib.

events.name: Quartz Dragon
events.house: None; approach the front of the boat

events.name: Severe Thunderstorm
details: Severe Thunderstorms are an event triggered by having Elena on the ship. Elena challenges Stella to collect at least 1/3 of the lightning strikes as a part of the quest Elena's Dharma.

Much like the usual Thunderstorms activated by Atul's presence on the ship, severe Thunderstorms are slightly faster paced. They are marked as red Thunderstorms on the map, and once completed will refresh within a few days. Completing them successfully will improve Elena's mood ("Elena is impressed by your work ethic").

events.name: Shadow Steel Orcs
details: Shadow Steel Orcs is a manually-triggered Event where XP Potion can be collected after the event is introduced by the Spirit Buck. Exactly 1 XP Potion will be collected for each corrupted Shadow Steel Orc that Stella defeats during the event.
Corrupted Orcs can be identified by their dark aura, and can only be defeated using Light Burst. Regular Orcs can be defeated by bumping into them or using Light Burst, and they only reward Glim.
The Spirit helper never leaves through the Everdoor (see Buck for more details).

events.name: Silver Dragon
events.house: None; approach the front of the boat

events.name: Thunderstorm
details: Atul will go to a location near-ish to Stella and will start to play his flute, then small circles of lightning will appear around Stella. The lightning within the circle will grow with time. When you go into the circle, the lightning will come down and Stella will hold a bottle to the sky, and you get Glim and often Lightning in a Bottle.

events.name: Tortoise Sisters
events.house: None; just walk to the front of the boat.
details: The three tortoise sisters; Olga, Masha, and Irina; are giant tortoises and points of interest that act as farms for wood or certain minerals.

Stella can "plant" something in each of the three nodes on the back of each of the tortoises. If a log was planted then a tree of the respective type will grow, and if a mineral was planted then a rock of the respective type will grow. After planting items in the nodes, Stella can talk with the tortoise to confirm she is done, after which the tortoise will disappear underwater and reappear some time later when the trees or rocks are finished growing.

events.name: Vending Machine
events.resource: Chocoblasterz, Crackers for Animals, Crispy Burlap Men, Health Nuts, Loose Spices, Muriel's Sticky Toffee, Space Sticks
details: The Vending Machine is a device available at Overbrook which, when interacted with, restores a portion of the hospital whereabouts, unlocking the next event and progressing Jackie's and Daria's quests.
Each item can only be bought once.

quests.title: Hello, my Name is Jackie
quests.description: Jackie would like his own room, so he could assist me better with my tasks on the boat.

quests.title: Hide and Seek
quests.description: Jackie has sent me a message through the pager. It sounds like he has "lost some people" and is "freaking out" over at Overbrook Hospital.

objectives.text: Go to Overbrook Hospital and ask Jackie about the “lost ppl.”
Find the three patients that look "hidden, lost or out of place" in Overbrook Hospital. (0/3)

notes: One patient is in the ruins to the far left of the area.
One patient is near the candy machine.
One patient is on the platform above and to the right of Jackie outside Daria's door.

quests.title: Hot Still-Scape for Six Colors
quests.description: Daria has asked me for a strange instrument: "a delicate schooner, with masts of crystal and sails of warped steel." Perhaps Francis would know about it?

objectives.text: Ask Francis the Wandering Merchant about Daria’s peculiar demand.
Complete Francis' errand to obtain the Strange Instrument.

notes: The errand Handle With Care requires:
2 Steel Sheet
2 Clear Glass Sheet
Or it will be these items, possibly depending on the game version:
3 silver ingots
3 squids
3 snow crabs
3 lobsters

quests.title: House Call
quests.description: Jackie has sent me a series of strange messages through the pager. I'm not sure what is going on, but I should be checking on him, over at Overbrook Hospital.

objectives.text: Go to Overbrook Hospital and find out what Jackie wanted.

notes: Complete The Old Guitarist to finish this quest.

quests.title: Humble Abode
quests.description: Astrid has received a letter from Olga, describing a nice house she might like. Olga hasn't got any news from the enigmatic Giovanni.
quests.prereq: Requires a Mailbox to start. Must have the Icebreaker to complete.

objectives.text: Ask about Giovanni on the island.
Ask about Giovanni on the island.
Talk to Astrid in front of Masha.
Plant some resources on Masha's shell.

quests.title: Hummingberg Preservation Society
quests.description: A cleaning effort. Why not! I do like it when things are clean.
quests.prereq: Sail to Alt Harbor after getting the Key for Stella's Cabin.

objectives.text: Get rid of those floating crates.
Talk to Jabari in Alt Harbor.

quests.title: I Get Cranky When I'm Hungry
quests.description: Gwen is famished. I better make her something and feed it to her.
notes: Once the kitchen is built, Gwen will give Stella Corn x3 to cook with.

quests.title: I Have My Doubts
quests.description: Something is afoot. Is Giovanni not sleeping at night? Is he leaving the boat at night? Maybe I should follow him around.
rewards: Hidden Achievement, depending on what you tell Astrid

objectives.text: Talk to Astrid the next morning.

quests.title: I Must Be Off
quests.description: Where is Gwen? I can't find her on the boat.

objectives.text: Talking to the other passengers will reveal Gwen went to Villa Maggiore.
Clicking on her door will start the I Must Be Off quest.
Talk to Gwen on your boat.

waypoints.why: Talking to the other passengers will reveal Gwen went to Villa Maggiore.

quests.title: Impression, Sunrise
quests.description: I've received a message from Overbrook's caretaker. Daria wants to see me. I should hurry.

quests.title: Indiscreet Meeting
quests.description: Why do I always get babysitting duty? I guess I'll follow Giovanni around!

objectives.text: After this Request, talking to Astrid will result in a choice of telling the truth, or lying about Giovanni's actions. Lying will give the Influence "Feels guilty for hurting loved ones. (-2)" to Giovanni.

quests.title: Indiscreet Shopping
quests.description: Shopping? Really? He's definitely more romantic than I could have imagined!

objectives.text: Head over to Bottom Line Corp.
Buy a Box of Chocolate from the shop in Bottom Line Corp.
Give the Box of Chocolate to Giovanni.
Talk to Giovanni on the boat.

notes: The second part of the quest doesn't start automatically, and once it does, the description becomes:
Roses? Such tender attention! Astrid will be delighted!

waypoints.why: Head over to Bottom Line Corp.

quests.title: It's Alive!
quests.description: Stanley wants to try fermentation. Let's let it rot in the cellar.

quests.title: It's an Island, Boss
quests.description: I've received a brochure for a place called Overbrook. I should check it out!

quests.title: Jiving Chives
quests.description: Summer has discovered a melody that significantly speeds up plant growth. I should try playing it in a garden.
quests.prereq: Have seeds growing in the garden

objectives.text: Play music to any sprouting plant in the garden. (0/5)

quests.title: Junior Architect
quests.description: Astrid thinks I should upgrade the blueprint station. More stations, I suppose.

objectives.text: Upgrade your blueprint station at Albert’s Shipyard.

waypoints.why: Upgrade your blueprint station at Albert’s Shipyard.

quests.title: Junior Architectural Designer
quests.description: Stanley wants some paper. I have to remember my arts and crafts class from grade school, I suppose. This kid is so full of energy.

objectives.text: Cook Sawdust and Household Glue together.

quests.title: Last Vacation
quests.description: Stanley looks and sounds hurt by the reactions to his play. Rejection is never fun.

quests.title: Laying at the Ley Line
quests.description: Summer has tasked me with building her a house. I should ask around to find someone who could design it.

quests.title: Letting It Go for Dummies
quests.description: With everything else failing, Jackie has shifted the blame of his problems on his poor education. He's motivated to better himself through reading.

quests.title: Lifestyles of the Rich and Famous
quests.description: So now it's come out! They want me to make it more grandiose.

objectives.text: Improve their house by adding something big.
Improve their house by adding something flashy.
Improve their house by adding something loud.

quests.title: Like Father, Like Son
quests.description: Beverly has another interesting story planned for me. Let's find out what she has planned.

objectives.text: The acetate is found on the second floor of the house on top of the island. You will need the Nordweiler House Key to enter.
Project the STRASBOURG, 1944 ACETATE in the Archive Room B-2522.

quests.title: Local Union 2187
quests.description: More food! Atul is unfillable.
notes: Completing this quest removes the mood penalty from Movie Night. Atul also gets a +2 mood bonus for being proud of his work.

quests.title: Lock and Load
quests.description: Gustav has charged me with setting up the groundwork for his planned exhibit. To that end, he needs me to equip the boat with a variety of stations.
notes: Gustav verifies you have the following: Sawmill, Loom, Foundry, and Mailbox. These are all necessary to get the Icebreaker and let Gustav on your boat, so unless you salvaged the sawmill, the quest will be completed right away. If you have the sawmill but are missing something else, the quest will complete but he will say “Well, it seems a couple of items are left unchecked. I’ll let you get to it.”

quests.title: Looter's Literary Review
quests.description: Buck is really excited about some magazine or journal or whatever it is.

objectives.text: Find the Crow's End Inc. lost bounty.

waypoints.why: Find the Crow's End Inc. lost bounty.

quests.title: Lost Bounty
quests.description: A map! Lost treasure! This is a real life pirate adventure.
quests.prereq: From the errand Little Bit of Sun

objectives.text: Find the location of the lost bounty.

quests.title: Lovers for Life
quests.description: I didn't know Astrid really missed Giovanni. There was so much tension between the two. I suppose you only find your true love once.

quests.title: Loyal Subject
quests.description: I've never heard and seen this Lizard King. Not a fan, to be honest.

quests.title: Mask Off
quests.description: One big job! One big score! What are these boys planning on my ship?

quests.title: Measure Twice, Cut Once
quests.description: The sawmill might not just spit out sawdust after this.
quests.prereq: Try using the sawmill and get sawdust.
notes: Atul gives you Maple Log x5 at the start of the Request.

quests.title: Mini Palace
quests.description: They say they want a palace to live in, but this feels a little bit too much.

quests.title: Missing Credentials
quests.description: Elena says my skills aren't up to the task. She wants me to add another one to my arsenal.
quests.prereq: Find Elena at Crow's End Inc.. Requires Double Jump, Glide, Zipline, Bounce, and the Mist Cleaner 1000.

quests.title: More Than Meets the Eye
quests.description: The Loom needs a bit of a makeover. Let's see what we can do!

quests.title: Movie Night
quests.description: I get it. I get food cravings too.
notes: Atul’s mood will take a hit (-2) from remembering his old family life until Stella completes Local Union 2187.

quests.title: Mysterious Word
quests.description: What is he talking about? What is a fakinhage? A breakfast food?
notes: It's an Egg. Translates to "F******' Egg". So… just give him an egg basically.
If you wait a day before turning in the quest, the description changes to:
Stanley says it's round and white and goes well with toast. What could it be?

quests.title: Nature Class
quests.description: Summer asked me if I could add a garden to the boat. She wants to use it as a classroom to teach me about gardening.

quests.title: New Beginnings
quests.description: Albert makes a good point! I should have a guest house for my new passengers that don't have a home yet.
quests.prereq: Stanley's upgrading pevious guest house to Stanley's Playroom.

quests.title: New Coordinates
quests.description: A message in a bottle indicated the coordinates of a mysterious treasure.

quests.title: Of Warts And Ropes
quests.description: Alice asked me to add a wardrobe to her house, and even offered to let me use it to store extra sets of clothes. She seems quite excited by the whole prospect.

objectives.text: Improve Alice's quarters with a Wardrobe.
Put on the Periwinkle Outfit from the wardrobe.

quests.title: On the Sea of Tranquility
quests.description: This lesson seems easy. No talking, just sailing towards the Everdoor... Easy might not be the right word here.

quests.title: Onboarding
quests.description: Jackie invited me for a tour of his workplace, Overbrook Hospital. I should follow him around.

objectives.text: Follow Jackie around at Overbrook Hospital.
Follow Jackie around at Overbrook Hospital.
Follow Jackie around at Overbrook Hospital.

quests.title: One Last Drink for the Road
quests.description: Giovanni needs a ride. I don't really feel like it, but he looks tired.

quests.title: One Last Time
quests.description: Gwen wants to go to the Everdoor. These might be our last moments together.

quests.title: One Shoop, Two Sheep
quests.description: I've been asked for some help in corralling some sheep back to their enclosure, in Mount Toroyama.

objectives.text: Get the sheep at Mount Toroyama to follow you by feeding it.
Bring the sheep back to its enclosure, close to Mount Toroyama's pier.
Find a second sheep and escort it back to Mount Toroyama's enclosure.

notes: The sheep on Mount Toroyama will eventually be a permanent passenger on Stella’s boat. It’s possible to change its color by reloading the save to before Stella first disembarks on the island.

quests.title: Past Lovers
quests.description: It's time for a big reunion. Hopefully, this goes well.

quests.title: Pauls vs. Simons
quests.description: These individuals are fighting for... I'm not sure about what... a song, maybe... anyway, I can't wait to see where this leads.

objectives.text: Find the fight score in Nordweiler.
Talk to this person (go back to the spirit in Edgeborough Lane)

notes: In Edgeborough Lane, you come across a group of people arguing about a song. When one of them spots you, he asks if you can help him by playing the song. To do so, you'll need to travel to Nordweiler first and purchase The Autumn End.

waypoints.why: Find the fight score in Nordweiler.
Talk to this person (go back to the spirit in Edgeborough Lane)

quests.title: Perimeter Sweep
quests.description: A passenger has complained about late night noise, but I'm not sure what this could be about. I should look around the boat.

objectives.text: Jackie can be found in any passenger’s house.
Talk to Jackie to complete this quest.

quests.title: Personal Connection
quests.description: Gwen is in need of some physical contact.

quests.title: Postscripta
quests.description: Elena has a few last words for you.

objectives.text: Complete Elena's errands with Francis. These include: Elena's Stipulation, Elena's Demand, and Elena's Lesson.
Improve your stations to their full potential.

quests.title: Pretty on the Inside
quests.description: Gwen's Lodge looks bare-bones. Maybe we could spice things up.

objectives.text: Improve Gwen's Lodge by fully decorating it.

quests.title: Retrograde
quests.description: Oh, no! I've got to tell Giovanni some hard truths.

objectives.text: Wait until Astrid is ready to talk to you.

quests.title: Ride The Lemon Dragon
quests.description: This young lemonade start-up needs my help. I've got to find them some delicious lemons.

objectives.text: Talk to delivery man in Southpoint Docks.
Talk to the lemonade vendor in Oxbury.

notes: In an earlier version of the game, apparently you would get actual lemons to take back, but the current version gives you plastic lemons. It's likely, based on the dialogue and fake lemons, that Stella is inadvertently helping with an illegal smuggling operation.

waypoints.why: Talk to delivery man in Southpoint Docks.
Talk to the lemonade vendor in Oxbury.

quests.title: Rooms by the Sea
quests.description: The area around Overbrook's vending machine looks much better now. I should try playing Daria's song there.

quests.title: Sea Master 2000
quests.description: According to my uncle, my fishing chair was broken. I should try it now.

quests.title: Seeds for the Future
quests.description: Gwen would like me to buy some seeds at a shop in Hummingberg.
rewards: Reasonable Raccoon Inc. prices in Hummingberg

objectives.text: Cut down a Maple Tree in Mosstein Cove.
Look at the shrine in the town square.
Buy some seeds for your Field from the merchant.
Plant any seed in the Field.

notes: Completing this quest will give Gwen a permanent mood bonus (+2) for shopping at Raccoon Inc.
Cutting down a tree on any island will count towards quest completion, but Stella does need to talk to Gwen on land about the trees to continue the quest.
Although Theodore claims to offer a discount during this quest, even if the displayed prices change, the actual Glims required and deducted while buying an item do not.

quests.title: Set Sail, Captain!
quests.description: I have the ability to travel the world now. How nice!

objectives.text: Start your boat in Stella's cabin.
Look at your Blueprint Station above your cabin.
Clear the trash off your boat through the edit mode.
Build the Guest House with the blueprint table.

quests.title: Slop 'N Slide
quests.description: Jackie has sent me a message through the pager. It sounds like there's a kitchen emergency over at Overbrook Hospital.

objectives.text: Go to Overbrook Hospital and ask Jackie about the “ktchn mrgncy.”
Get food from the cafeteria at Overbrook Hospital.
Distribute the cafeteria food to three Overbrook Hospital patients.

quests.title: Smash! Smash!
quests.description: All this noise and violence can't be good for them! I suppose having a crusher might calm them down.

quests.title: Snack Attack
quests.description: I've met my old colleague Jackie at Overbrook Hospital. He asked me to get him a snack from the hospital's vending machine.

objectives.text: Use the vending machine at Overbrook to buy Jackie a Chocoblasterz candy bar.

quests.title: Something to Write Home About
quests.description: I've been getting letters upon letters. Maybe I should check my mailbox more often!

objectives.text: Head over to Bottom Line Corp.

waypoints.why: Head over to Bottom Line Corp.

quests.title: Sous-Chef Extraordinaire
quests.description: Apparently I have to prepare food and give it to Atul. What a day.

objectives.text: You will need to cook the item for each invited person from the Request, "Family Style", not for all people. The recipe is given to you if you do not know it.
Cook a Noodle Soup for Astrid.
Cook a Green Salad for Elena.
Give the cooked items to Atul.

quests.title: Spice Up Your Life
quests.description: Atul thinks I should take some time and improve his house.

objectives.text: Improve Atul's house by adding a Shower.
Improve Atul's house by adding a Desk.
Improve Atul's house by adding a Picture Frame.

quests.title: Spring Feet
quests.description: I've got two Obols. Let's see what happens when I activate that shrine in Hummingberg.

objectives.text: Go activate the shrine in Hummingberg.

waypoints.why: Go activate the shrine in Hummingberg.

quests.title: Stella's Last Voyage
quests.description: My time has come. I am no longer alone. Lily and mom are with me, holding my hands, somewhere out there.

objectives.text: Bring Stella & Daffodil to the Everdoor.

waypoints.why: Bring Stella & Daffodil to the Everdoor.

quests.title: Sticky Fingers
quests.description: This strange man wants me to jump in a pond for a lemon.

objectives.text: Recover your new friend's lost lemon.

quests.title: Striking out on my Own
quests.description: I don't remember all of these things. It’s been so long. To hear Lily's voice is such a sweet song.

objectives.text: Meet with Lily at the Furogawa Shrine, during nighttime.

waypoints.why: Meet with Lily at the Furogawa Shrine, during nighttime.

quests.title: Taillé dans l'Or Massif
quests.description: Gustav, upon joining the crew, commented on the "drabness" of the boat's prow. He would enjoy a figurehead very much.

objectives.text: Upgrade the boat with a figurehead.

quests.title: Taking the Low Road
quests.description: Alice might have some difficulty walking down from her house to the deck of the boat. I could lower her house so she has an easier time getting around.

objectives.text: Move Alice's house down to the deck level.
Check on Alice in the morning.
Walk Alice back to her house in the evening.

quests.title: Taking Time Off
quests.description: Gwen doesn't feel so good right now. I should let her breathe for awhile.

objectives.text: Wait for Gwen to feel better.

quests.title: Terrible Subject
quests.description: I did bad, I think.

quests.title: The Beginning and the End
quests.description: Beverly said something about getting a Super Saver Discount Book in Ambertown Park to buy the Archive Room B-2522! Maybe I should check it out.

objectives.text: Buy the Archive Room B-2522 on Edgeborough Lane
Try the Archive Room B-2522 projector
Project the MATH 116 - LECTURE NOTES ACETATE in the Archive Room B-2522

quests.title: The Coziest Cottage
quests.description: Alice seems eager to join me on my travels but does not want to bother me. Perhaps she would accept an invitation if I built her some quarters? She described a house very passionately.

objectives.text: Build a cozy cottage for Alice.
Tell Alice about the house you built for her.

quests.title: The Depths of the Pit
quests.description: Jackie does not wish to stay on the boat anymore. I should respect his wishes, and lead him away with dignity.

quests.title: The Diffracted Cabinet
quests.description: Summer has asked me to gather a variety of gemstones and crystals that she could use to bring herself back to health. She is not picky, and requires only three different kinds.
notes: Summer gets a temporary mood boost (+1) when she is offered a gemstone during this quest.
Her summary of the gem’s use in her spiritual practice is on the item page.

quests.title: The Dog Whisperer
quests.description: Someone is asking for my help.

quests.title: The Drawing Board
quests.description: Atul says I can upgrade my boat at Albert's Shipyard.

objectives.text: Upgrade your blueprint station again at Albert's Shipyard.

waypoints.why: Upgrade your blueprint station again at Albert's Shipyard.

quests.title: The Fires of Tondor
quests.description: The fires of Tondor have to be lit. Sounds like lighthouses that need to be switched on.

objectives.text: Talk to Buck on the boat.

quests.title: The Great Wave
quests.description: The area around Overbrook's power station looks much better, now. I should try playing Daria's song there.

objectives.text: Play Daria's song at the power station.

Go to Overbrook's power station (it's to the right of the boat you ride in on). There, go to the top of one of the buildings. There will be some colourful paper. Interact with it and complete the platforming.

waypoints.why: Go to Overbrook's power station (it's to the right of the boat you ride in on). There, go to the top of one of the buildings. There will be some colourful paper. Interact with it and complete the platforming.

quests.title: The High-Wire Act
quests.description: He sure seems hell bent on escaping this place. What should I do? Find some Linen Fabric for him or go talk to the doctors?

quests.title: The House of Bau
quests.description: What's a multipurpose area? And why does Gustav need one? This seems like a lot of work for one person! I do hope it will liven the mood on the boat.

quests.title: The Ice Breaker
quests.description: Atul says I can upgrade my boat at Albert's Shipyard.
quests.prereq: Try to sail through the ice barrier.

objectives.text: Add the Ice Breaker upgrade to your boat.

quests.title: The Incident
quests.description: Jackie has sent me a message through the pager. He sounded very, very mad. I should probably head to Overbrook right away.

objectives.text: Check on Jackie at Overbrook Hospital.

notes: Once you give Daria a strange instrument for one of her quests, Jackie will get mad at you, and then the quest will end. After the quest ends, you will get a shenanigan from a spirit standing nearby, then you can continue from there.

quests.title: The Last Supper
quests.description: The area around Overbrook's cafeteria looks much better now. I should try playing Daria's song there.

quests.title: The Lizard King
quests.description: What's a Lizard King? I wish I knew!

objectives.text: Meet the Lizard King in Edgeborough Lane.

waypoints.why: Meet the Lizard King in Edgeborough Lane.

quests.title: The Master Forger
quests.description: Gustav suggested adding a Smithy to the boat, hinting that we might need it later.

quests.title: The Metastatic Coil
quests.description: Summer had a new vision of another, more threatening dragon. I should visit it as soon as possible.

objectives.text: Wait for Summer to gather her thoughts.

quests.title: The More, the Merrier
quests.description: Gwen is convinced that other lost souls are out there. Let's go see.

objectives.text: Find a passenger on Barkensheim Creek.

notes: The passenger in Hummingberg requires either the Key for Hummingberg or Double Jump.

waypoints.why: Find a passenger on Barkensheim Creek.

quests.title: The Night Watch
quests.description: I've received a message from Daria's caretaker. She would like to see me.

objectives.text: Talk to Daria in her room on Overbrook.

quests.title: The Old Guitarist
quests.description: Jackie was not at his usual post, and I managed to enter the "difficult patient"'s room. She looks unresponsive, but perhaps I can snap her out of it?

objectives.text: Find a way to wake the “difficult patient.”
Play the strange melody in the "difficult” patient's room.

notes: Examine the notes at the desk in the room, then press the button to play guitar (same as for growing in garden).

quests.title: The Old Violinist
quests.description: With his exhibition finished, Gustav says he's ready to move on, and asked me to bring him to the Everdoor.

quests.title: The One from Downstairs
quests.description: This person sounds oddly familiar. I just can't put my finger on it. Let's see where this takes us.

objectives.text: Find someone dressed in black in Hummingberg.
Welcome your new passenger on the boat.

quests.title: The Oneness and the Wholeness
quests.description: Summer has a special lesson to teach me. She would like me to meet her on the cliff in Mount Toroyama.

objectives.text: Talk with Summer on the pier.
Talk with Summer on the cliffside.
Sit by the boulder next to Summer.
Talk to Summer on the pier.

quests.title: The Raft of the Medusa
quests.description: Daria, true to herself, has mysteriously asked me to play her song just outside of her room. I should try it!

objectives.text: Play Daria's song outside of Daria's room at Overbrook.

notes: You'll want to go to the cluster of sticky notes on the outside of Daria's room.

quests.title: The Real Spiritfarer
quests.description: Wait? Are there other Spiritfarers around the world? I better go fish for that lost Everlight.

objectives.text: Fish around the waters of Overbrook.

notes: You will fish up a Light Bulb, a key item that "will shine as bright as an Everlight!"

quests.title: The Reviews Are In!
quests.description: Stanley wants to know if people liked his play. Let's see...

objectives.text: Ask whoever you invited about Stanley's play.

quests.title: The Rhythm of the Night
quests.description: A light show at sea? This I got to see!

quests.description: Gustav needs a desk in his office. He has heard of a master woodworker living in Oxbury, but couldn't get in touch with him. Perhaps his partner, working in a café there, could help us out?

Find the woodworker hanging around in Ambertown Park.
Bring a [[Surf and Turf to the woodworker.
(Or): Bring a Casserole to the woodworker.
(Or): Bring a Grilled Fish to the woodworker.
Pay the woodworker his fee of 450,000 glims.

Improve Gustav's Gallery with the vintage modernist desk.

waypoints.why: Find the woodworker's partner in a café in Oxbury.
Find the woodworker hanging around in Ambertown Park.
DO NOT TELL the woodworker's partner in Oxbury.

quests.title: The Silver Company
quests.description: An adventure with a peculiar Oracle tree and role-playing friends. Buck sure has an active imagination...

objectives.text: Find Buck's friend Jerome in Hummingberg.
Find Buck's friend Bryan in Bottom Line Corp..
Find Buck's friend Bob in Oxbury.
Give Buck Popcorn, a Corndog, and Toffee.
Head to Nordweiler and talk to Buck.
Talk to Buck on the boat.
Talk to the Oracle Tree at Furogawa.

waypoints.why: Find Buck's friend Jerome in Hummingberg.
Find Buck's friend Bryan in Bottom Line Corp..
Find Buck's friend Bob in Oxbury.
Head to Nordweiler and talk to Buck.
Talk to the Oracle Tree at Furogawa.

quests.description: The cafeteria at Overbrook Hospital has run out of supplies. Jackie has asked me for some.

objectives.text: Bring five bags of Rice to Jackie.

quests.title: The Sommelier
quests.description: A bottle from the sea. A message from far away. I should open it.
quests.prereq: Fish up the Message in a Bottle

objectives.text: Atul really wants you to open a bottle from the sea.

quests.description: Me… a movie star? What an absurd idea! I better help this poor man. He probably hit his head or something. He's seeing stars everywhere.
quests.prereq: Rock Destroyer to reach Ingrid, or Mist Cleaner 1000 to reach Katherine.

Talk to Katherine in Obscure Canopy.
Talk to Larry in Nordsee Pier.

waypoints.why: Talk to Ingrid in Old-Central District.
Talk to Katherine in Obscure Canopy.
Talk to Larry in Nordsee Pier.

quests.title: The Titanic Days
quests.description: That experience with Daria was quite something, but I think it's helping her. Perhaps if I help improve Overbrook she'll get even better?

objectives.text: Buy new items at the Vending Machine.

quests.title: This Shed Is My Shed
quests.description: Hopefully, he won't work too long on that door.

objectives.text: Let this upset man do his thing.

notes: The shenanigan can be started by returning to Villa Maggiore at any point after completing Back to the Past, but cannot be completed until Gwen goes through the Everdoor.

quests.title: Three Sisters
quests.description: Astrid says a friend is waiting for us. Who knows what surprise awaits us!
